【原视频简介】
OpenAI CEO and co-founder Sam Altman discusses the rollout of GPT-6 Astra, the company's latest AI model, and says the tech industry has done a terrible job of communicating the benefits of AI. Speaking with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg The Close," Altman also says he assumes the company will go public one day.
